in_hebrew.name: Hatcher
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו From the old English hathe, hatch meaning to hatch, or hewer, maker
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hatcher הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Hatcher is of Old English origin and is derived from the words hathe and hatch, which mean 'to hatch' or 'to make'. This name was often given to individuals who were skilled craftsmen or artisans, particularly those involved in the hatching of eggs. In the Middle Ages, it was also a common surname for those who were hatters or makers of hats.
